[LIVE in PEACE] 케이시 (Kassy) - 언제나 사랑해 | DMZ OPEN FESTIVAL | LIVE CLIP | EP.2

#Kassy#DMZ_OPEN_Festival#ad#New1theKOriginal#1theK#원더케이#원더케이오리지널

The special project to find the true meaning of peace by looking into the natural ecology, peace,
culture and even the heart-wrenching history of the DMZ in commemoration of the 70th anniversary of armistice, ‘LIVE in PEACE:DMZ OPEN PROJECT’
The second destination is ‘Aegibong Peace Ecopark’ along with the soulful vocal goddess, Kassy!
From the sad story of the Aegibong Peak nestling along the Jo River where the nature is alive to the
beautiful ecosystem that connects between the south and north and the signature of peace picked by Kassy, Let’s go to the place full of fresh and green mystique together!
